title: Pilot 99mTechnetium-MIBI Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography - Computed Tomography (SPECT-CT) in Papillary Carcinoma (CA) Thyroid
brief_summary: The purpose of this trial is to see if the 99mTechnetium-MIBI SPECT-CT can be a tool for preoperative evaluation of cervical node metastasis in papillary thyroid cancer.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* papillary thyroid cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* Bleeding abnormality
* Prior history of head and neck cancer
* can not perform 99mTechnetium-MIBI SPECT-CT
* can not perform 131I remnant Ablation
* Prior any head and neck surgery within 3 months
* Prior deep neck infection within 3 months
